overview_description.description: Jabu is an e-commerce marketplace where shop owners can order, source, and stock their products, as well as execute the last-mile distribution for FMCG brands. Jabu connects brands with a large network of shops in Southern Africa. JABU orders products for small retail shops and also provides data services to manufacturers and suppliers.
